summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false), regenerated initramfs, verified the module refuses to load immediately, then rebooted node1 and confirmed the block persists across a genuine reboot (proven by changed boot_id) along with healthy system state.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb_storage not loaded, captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d
Unloaded module (already unloaded) and regenerated initramfs for all kernels via update-initramfs -u -k all
Verified 'modprobe usb-storage' fails immediately with Operation not permitted (now-behavior)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, systemctl is-system-running=running, module not loaded
Triggered reboot via backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Confirmed SSH connection refused mid-reboot, then polled until node1 was reachable again
Captured new boot_id 2f50cf52-4993-4746-92b4-c44a69dfa085 proving an actual reboot occurred
Post-restart verification: uptime 0 min, systemctl is-system-running=running, usb_storage not loaded, blacklist config file intact, manual modprobe load still refused

evidence.summary: Confirmed usb_storage module not loaded and captured initial boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d before any change.
Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf containing 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/false', confirmed via cat.
Unloaded module, regenerated initramfs, then attempted 'modprobe usb-storage' which failed with 'Operation not permitted'; lsmod confirmed module absent.
Captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d, systemctl is-system-running=running, and usb_storage not loaded immediately before reboot.
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' command returned 'reboot_triggered' acknowledgement before the node dropped connectivity.
SSH was refused mid-reboot (connection down), then reconnected with a new boot_id 2f50cf52-4993-4746-92b4-c44a69dfa085, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart persistence: module still blocked from loading, both now and after reboot, with healthy system recovery
evidence.summary: After reboot (uptime 0 min), systemctl is-system-running=running, usb_storage not loaded, blacklist config file intact on disk, and a manual 'modprobe usb-storage' attempt still fails with 'Operation not permitted', proving the block persists across reboot.
